Chip licensing is one of the specific issues investors expect the summit to address, keeping US semiconductor leaders such as[NVIDIA (NVDA)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/nvda/) in focus alongside their Asian suppliers. The buying also fit a pattern of firm Asian sessions in recent weeks, including a rally tied to[the Bank of Japan and a weaker yen](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/boj-rate-hike-yen-slide-asian-stock-rally/) .


## Kospi and Hang Seng Pace the Regional Scoreboard


Mainland Chinese benchmarks also firmed. The Shanghai Composite gained 1% to 3,949.91 and the blue-chip CSI 300 rose 0.71%, according to[Investing.com](https://ca.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/asia-stocks-climb-tech-shares-lead-gains-ahead-of-trumpxi-summit-4845685) , while Japan's market was closed for a public holiday. ## Sectors to Watch at the Trump-Xi Summit


The summit puts several US sectors in the spotlight. Investors are watching soybean purchase volumes, semiconductor licensing language, and auto and battery localization commitments as the clearest gauges of any progress, according to[Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/trumpxi-summit-outlook-us-stocks-and-sectors-to-watch-93CH-4908255) .


Agricultural traders such as[Archer Daniels Midland (ADM)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/adm/) are sensitive to Chinese demand, after China bought roughly one million tons of US soybeans in the week of September 10.


Aerospace is another barometer.[Boeing (BA)](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/ba/) remains tied to a Chinese pledge to take 200 aircraft, made at a May summit in Beijing, though delivery timelines and financing terms are still unclear, per[Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/trumpxi-summit-outlook-us-stocks-and-sectors-to-watch-93CH-4908255) .


Goldman Sachs' base case is a "ceasefire, not treaty" outcome, in which both sides extend the existing trade truce rather than reach a breakthrough, a result the bank says is already partly priced in. That truce, which caps tariffs near 20%, is set to expire in early November.


## Wall Street Eyes Tariffs and AI Safety on the Agenda


US futures rose after Bessent's comments, building on Friday's session in which the S&P 500 added 0.2% and the Nasdaq composite gained 0.4%, while the Dow slipped 0.2%, according to the[Associated Press](https://www.local10.com/business/2026/09/21/stocks-advance-after-bessent-says-talks-with-china-were-successful-before-trump-xi-meeting/) . Trade, reciprocal tariff reductions, and AI safety are all expected to feature on the agenda when the two leaders meet.


For investors on[Gotrade](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/) , the week is a reminder that headline risk around the summit can move US-listed names quickly in either direction. The asymmetry, analysts note, favors a faster reaction to concrete commitments than to a stalemate, which most consider unlikely, per[Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/trumpxi-summit-outlook-us-stocks-and-sectors-to-watch-93CH-4908255) .
